description: Client-side script for the 'Student Group' doctype in ERPNext, managing form behaviors, queries, and actions related to student groups.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Initializes form queries and behaviors when the Student Group form loads.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Adds custom action buttons and updates UI elements when the form is refreshed.

methods.name: group_based_on
methods.description: Adjusts form fields based on the selected grouping basis (Batch, Course, Activity).

methods.name: get_students
methods.description: Fetches and adds students to the group based on selected criteria.

methods.name: instructors_add
methods.description: Sets query for instructor selection in the 'Student Group Instructor' child table.
